CA.rationale: No attention/processing condition linked to content organization/access was stated.

COD.rationale: Content (red coordinate), its presentation/organization metadata (origin) and a status-like provenance are all explicitly given for the same referent/time.

A.rationale: No attention/allocation or content-processing condition is linked to organization or access.

C.rationale: Multiple explicit content identifiers (color attributes with coordinate sets) are reported.

D.rationale: Content coordinates are listed separately from origin/provenance metadata, distinguishing identification from status/organization.

O.rationale: The report specifies how content is organized/presented (origin provenance, axis directions) for both current and conditional candidate entries.
